messages:
Olivia (CSM): Heads up — GreenCrest usage dropped sharply yesterday after they swapped their data lead. Saw volume fall from ~10k calls/day to ~800/day and a couple of seats quiet. Procurement pinged me about a competitor PoC.
Sanjay (AE): Ugh. Do we have fresh telemetry? Can we confirm it's not a schema change or API key rotation?
Maya (Support Engineer): Quick check: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) as reqs_weekly FROM inference_events WHERE account_id='greencrest' AND ts >= '2024-03-31' AND ts < '2024-04-07';
-- result: reqs_weekly = 800  (previous weekly avg ~10,200)
```
Maya (Support Engineer): No obvious 5xx spikes in the logs, tokens per request steady. Looks like client stopped sending batched jobs from their worker.
Olivia (CSM): They mentioned the new CTO is doing a cost review. Procurement is shortlisting a competitor for a small PoC.
Leo (Product): Any platform changes on our side for that customer or model variants? Rollout history shows no config changes for GreenCrest in last 30 days.
Sanjay (AE): I scheduled a sync with their new CTO + procurement for Thu 11am PT. Olivia — can you prep a one-pager that shows our cost/latency vs typical competitor benchmarks and call out Dedicated + reserved credits as an option?
Olivia (CSM): On it. Also proposing a 30-day Dedicated credit extension and a 1-hr technical onboarding for their new ML lead to re-establish trust. Thoughts?
Maya (Support Engineer): Extension is low friction and might re-open traffic. Technical session likely helpful — we can demo prefix caching + batching improvements we enabled last quarter.
ops-bot: Reminder: GreenCrest flagged "renewal-risk". Owner set to Olivia (CSM). Due: 48h.
Olivia (CSM): @Sanjay can you pull recent eval logs and token mix so I can include usage delta in the one-pager? Also if anyone has recent notes from the CSM handoff, drop them here.
Sanjay (AE): Pulling logs now. Will post quick highlights and a short CSV before EOD.
Leo (Product): Recommend adding a slide with a side-by-side: Hosted per-token cost vs Dedicated per-token at their observed throughput, and a small throughput plan for canary to avoid cold drops.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks — will assemble. If we don't get traction after the call i'll propose a short pilot with a guaranteed SLA and a pricing demonstration. :thumbsup:
Maya (Support Engineer): I'll prepare the tech session checklist and share a timeline for enabling KV cache on their pipeline.
Sanjay (AE): Posted logs summary: weekly reqs 800 vs baseline 10.2k, no errors, top 3 endpoints unchanged. Sharing CSV link in private.
Olivia (CSM): Great. Team — let's treat this as a high-priority renewal-risk triage. I'll update the ticket and the prep doc and share before the CTO call.
Olivia (CSM): Action items: 1) Olivia — one-pager + credit proposal; 2) S anjay — logs + token mix; 3) Maya — tech session plan; 4) Leo — cost slide. Revisit after the Thu call.
